{{Top|leg}}
'''Republic Navy Transmission''' was a communication system standard used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] were equipped with software that allowed them to communicate with computers that used the Republic Navy Transmission system.<ref name="R-Series">{{JournalCite|7|The History of R-Series Astromech Droids}}</ref>
